name: Commerce Promo Link
description: Apply a promo code via URL.
project_description: Commerce Promo Link lets a shareable URL, /commerce/promotion/{code}, place a Drupal Commerce promotion coupon code into the visitor's private tempstore so it is applied automatically to their cart. Requires commerce_promotion. The controller validates the coupon (exists, enabled, within usage limits and start/end date windows) and, on success, shows a message and redirects to the front page (or to a core-sanitized ?destination). An order event subscriber then writes the single coupon onto the draft cart order on the next add-to-cart / cart / node / product page view, and a 'promo_link_only' Commerce condition can restrict a promotion so it applies only when it arrived through such a link.
